atomic_row_command.requirement: capture all fields atomically; hold through final output; no next row until drain

auxiliary_outputs.requirement: bind local consumers or price their transport separately; payload totals exclude valid, fault and observation ports

serial_alternative.buffering: reserve all row slots, gather scores before score replay, then drain exponents to P.V before gathering PV

complete_row_storage.excludes: configuration, ECC, tags, validity, occupancy and implementation padding; double buffering not included

reservation_fallback.status: sized minimum component; no RTL/physical qualification
reservation_fallback.protection: SECDED64+8 per64data bits; SRAM protection retained
reservation_fallback.layout: disjoint score,PV,exp,and packedBF16 regions; atomic single-row ownership until output drain
reservation_fallback.SRAM_ports: one9216-bit read and one9216-bit write per stream edge, each distributed over36macros
reservation_fallback.ingress: gather8beats before writing whole protected vector; retain one protected assembly vector
reservation_fallback.egress: capture every fixed-rate exp vector; pack two BF16 vectors per SRAM row
reservation_fallback.drain: drain all exponentials after exp capture and before PV fill/replay; drain BF16 after normalize completes
reservation_fallback.replay: 40 score edges at T640; drain exp to attention P.V; gather32 PV vectors; replay PV only after den_v
reservation_fallback.no_ready_output_requirement: exp and BF16 output phases must not overlap; prove before sharing write port
reservation_fallback.admission: reserve capacity, NOT all input data, before starting core; PV depends on exp output; no next command until final drain
exact_component_gate: output capacity conserved under indefinitely stalled drain
reject early dispatch and duplicate/extra beats
missing: measured parent occupancy and token latency

protected_lane_component.macro_clock_assumption: read sampled on stream edge; raw code captured on following edge before any syndrome logic
protected_lane_component.controller: one valid pipeline per replicated64-bit lane; row address, ownership and error aggregation require separate protection
protected_lane_component.critical_path_contribution: one encode edge before macro write; three code-input-to-decoded-valid pipeline edges; compose each dependent read/write at parent join
protected_lane_component.build_scope: minimum codec component exactness only; no parent SRAM or CDC adoption

phase_controller_component.protection: onehot state plus complement; duplicated-complement count,tag,short-row,denominator-ready and settle count; fail closed on mismatch
phase_controller_component.domain: stream1.2; incoming row bus must already be synchronized
phase_controller_component.interface: tagged vector commits and drains; controls actual memory region/offset, but payload packing and read pipeline remain separate
missing: physical SS/FF and parent timing composition

direct_stream_alternative.status: requires actual producer/consumer placement and bandwidth; no free shared-memory or CDC assumption

obligations: bind exact producer and consumer per port
price SRAM ports, protection and muxes for chosen row buffers
bind physical clock domains, crossing latency and reset ownership
prove no overflow: core has no backpressure ports
preserve golden row and reduction order with atomic configuration
measure row-level latency; compose dependencies rather than sum overlapping link and compute times
place measured pin stations and verify channel capacity at actual full width
